title: A signed-in member who sets an age under 18 is still told their workouts are saved automatically
what: Since the under-18 fix, the background copy quietly stops sending anything once the profile age is 10 to 17. Only the sign-in button tells the member. A member already signed in who edits the age (the profile saves as you type) keeps seeing "Your workouts are saved to your MettleUp account automatically. Last saved: <old date>", or "N changes are waiting for the internet", for ever. Nothing new is saved and the line never says why.
expected: Once the age stops the saving, the backup line says plainly that saving on MettleUp is off for members under 18 and that workouts stay on this phone only.
who: signed-in members whose profile age is, or is changed to, under 18
how_often: every time they open Settings after the age change
fix_line: Have the backup line check the same age rule and show the under-18 sentence instead of "saved automatically"

title: If the coach comes back, its "this week" counts the last 7 days while Home counts from Monday
what: Asked for a weekly summary, the offline coach answers "This week: N workouts" using the last 7 days. Home and the rest of the app count "this week" from Monday. On a Wednesday a member who trained last Friday, Saturday and Monday hears 3 workouts from the coach and sees 1 on Home.
expected: The coach's "this week" uses the same Monday-to-today window as Home, or says "last 7 days".
who: members using the coach, once it is switched back on
how_often: every weekly summary asked on any day but Sunday
fix_line: Label it "Last 7 days" or count from Monday like Home

title: If the coach comes back, "am I improving" says weight lifted is up 0% for a new member and shows a drop early in each week
what: The answer compares the last 4 weeks with the 4 before. A member with nothing in the older 4 weeks is told weight lifted is "up 0%" though everything is new. The recent 4 weeks include the current week, which on a Monday holds one day, so a steady member reads a drop with no reason given.
expected: A member with no older weeks hears that there is not enough history yet; the comparison uses full weeks only, or says the current week is not finished.
who: members using the coach, once it is switched back on
how_often: every improvement question from a member under 2 months in, and early in every week
fix_line: Compare full weeks only and say "not enough history yet" when the older weeks are empty
